vlm.face_critique: Facial proportions, smile, and glasses translate decently from the concept, though fine edge definition around the eyes and mouth is softened.
vlm.secondary_critique: The scepter and crown match the general silhouette, but small filigree details and the base nameplate text lack sharpness.
vlm.back_critique: Hair volume and braided updo remain structurally sound from the rear, with dress patterning reasonably aligned.
structural_flaws: Softened geometric definition on hand grip around scepter
aesthetic_flaws: Gold embroidery textures are slightly blurry compared to concept
Reduced specular contrast on jewelry and crown
